verdict.rationale: SerpApi has no documented batch endpoint. Its async mode lets a caller submit searches and retrieve them later through the Searches Archive API, so client-side fan-out over many queries is possible. That is a workaround rather than a native bulk operation, and the evidence only implies it. Missing for 10: a native batch/bulk search endpoint, documentation of submitting many queries in one call, rate or concurrency guidance for bulk jobs, and hands-on corroboration of high-volume use.
